title: Procurement analysis
description: Ranked historical suppliers, supplier pool health and external market expansion for one procurement.
disclaimer: Sourcing intelligence from historical procurement data and curated evidence. It supports market research and is not a procurement approval.

initial.title: Which procurement should we analyze?
initial.description: Enter a lot ID or open the primary demo case to see recommended suppliers, pool concentration and new market candidates.

loading.title: Analyzing procurement {lot}
loading.hint: Larger procurements with many items take a few seconds.

notFound.title: Procurement not found
notFound.description: Lot {lot} is not in the historical procurement data. Check the ID or open a demo case.

partial.title: Partial analysis
partial.description: Some sections could not be loaded. The available sections are shown below.

semanticUnavailable: Semantic search is unavailable right now. Recommendations use product text and OKPD2 matching only.

timeline.historicalHint: Only procurements published before this date are used for recommendations and pool health.
timeline.externalHint: Curated market evidence used to discover alternatives; collected after the procurement date.
timeline.externalNone: No curated external evidence for the categories of this procurement

summary.title: Procurement

market.top1Explain: The leading supplier won {share}% of observed awards in this category.
market.hhiHint: HHI ranges from 0 to 1; higher means fewer suppliers win most awards. It is an analytical indicator, not a regulatory threshold.

market.collapsedCount: {count, plural, one {# more category} other {# more categories}}

external.title: External market expansion
external.subtitle: New suppliers found outside the historical procurement data, from curated public evidence.
external.disclaimer: Candidates are leads for market research, not suppliers approved for award.

external.exactOkpd2No: Sources support the product type; they do not assert this exact OKPD2 code.
external.exactOkpd2Yes: A source asserts this exact OKPD2 code.
